subject: Alignment note: pilot charter, metrics & infra access (ClearView Analytics)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@clearview.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment note: pilot charter, metrics & infra access (ClearView Analytics)

Tom — thanks for the time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and the concrete next steps so everyone is aligned. I captured scope, success metrics, owners, and the access items we need to start the pilot. Please reply with any corrections.

Highlights from the call
- Primary pain: search and insight latency for exploratory queries across historical datasets (avg user session drop at ~1.2s). Current cost per query is variable; ClearView wants a repeatable SLA and 40–60% cost reduction for inference.
- Target use case: real-time summarization + semantic ranking for analyst workflows (desktop web UI, not embedding-only batch jobs).

Proposed pilot scope (agreed):
1) Inference surface: up to 10k daily queries routed through Redwood hosted runtime (single region, us-west).
2) Dataset: 150GB of compressed documents (S3 URI you’ll provide) + representative query set (~500 prompts).
3) Model profile: open-codec LlamaX-13B quantized runtime (we can fall back to a 7B variant for p95 latency tests).

Success metrics (KPI baseline + target):
- Latency: p95 generation + ranking < 300ms (current p95 ~1.2s)
- Quality: top-3 rerank precision lift >= 12% vs baseline (your eval set)
- Cost: token cost reduction >= 45% vs your current GPU-hosted baseline over a 14-day window

Owners & Roles
- ClearView: Tom (eng lead) — provide S3 access, sample queries, and a point for infra/IP allowlist
- Redwood: Soojin (SE lead) — pilot-run orchestration, prompt set/eval framework; Ben (AE) — commercial touchpoint; Marissa (CS) — onboarding & success metrics tracking

Access & setup checklist (we need these to start onboarding):
- S3 read-only role or temporary credentials for the 150GB sample bucket (prefix + sample manifest).
- IP allowlist: 54.200.12.0/24 and 3.210.45.0/24 (Redwood egress for the hosted runtime)
- Service account for telemetry: one low-privilege key that can post status to your internal webhook (optional; we can use our managed telemetry if not provided)
- MFA & compliance note: we will send a short MFA checklist for secure access (attached).

Immediate next steps (this week):
1) Tom — share S3 URI + sample prompt set by EOD Thursday (2027-05-06).
2) Redwood — we’ll provision a sandbox runtime and share temporary credentials + run initial health checks within 48 hours of receiving S3 access.
3) Set a follow-up sync for Tuesday 2027-05-11 to present first-run latency/quality numbers and confirm gating metrics for the 14-day trial.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.docx (outline & timeline), ClearView-POC-Data-Requirements.xlsx, Redwood-Quickstart-MFA.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Blake <tom@clearview.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Ng <claire.ng@clearview.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment note: pilot charter, metrics & infra access (ClearView Analytics)

Thanks Soojin — this looks right to me. A few clarifications from our side:
- We can provision an S3 prefix (s3://clearview-poc/sample-150gb/) and will create a manifest file with file hashes by tomorrow. I’ll also add a short README with privacy tags.
- IP allowlist: those subnets look fine but our security team prefers we use an inventory-friendly DNS name; I’ll ask them to accept the CIDRs as-is for the sandbox.
- For quality eval: Claire will upload the 500 prompt set and a small labeled sample of 200 queries with expected outputs; will that format work?

One ask: any chance you can include a simple latency dashboard (Grafana link or static CSV) we can import into our observability stack? That’ll help our product folks track the p95 delta during the 14-day window.

I’ll have the S3 manifest + prompts in the drive link by EOD Thursday. Can you confirm the sandbox region is us-west-2?

—
Tom Blake
Head of Engineering, ClearView Analytics
tom@clearview.ai | +1 (206) 555-0179

On Wed, May 5, 2027 at 15:08 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message clipped)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@clearview.ai>
Cc: Claire Ng <claire.ng@clearview.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment note: pilot charter, metrics & infra access (ClearView Analytics)

Tom / Claire — perfect, appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming the small points and adding timeline + deliverables:

Confirmed items
- Region: yes — sandbox will be us-west-2 (we will pin the model runner there for consistency).
- Prompt/eval format: 500 prompts + 200 labeled samples is ideal. We’ll ingest prompts as newline-delimited JSON with a simple schema (we’ll attach a template).
- Dashboard: Redwood will provide a lightweight CSV export of latency/throughput with p50/p95/p99 buckets; I’ll share a Grafana snapshot link after the initial run.

Pilot timeline (provisional)
- Thu 2027-05-06: ClearView provides S3 manifest + prompt set + allowlist confirmation
- Fri 2027-05-07: Redwood provisions sandbox runtime, confirms keys & runs smoke tests
- Mon 2027-05-10: First-run report (latency + quality sample) — initial optimizations applied (batching, KV cache config)
- Tue 2027-05-11: Sync meeting to review first-run results and confirm go/no-go for 14-day evaluation window

Deliverables from each side
- ClearView: S3 access manifest, prompt set, labeled sample, IP allowlist decision, telemetry webhook (optional)
- Redwood: sandbox credentials, initial 48-hr run, latency CSV + prompt evaluation report, recommended quantization/config suggestions for cost target

Action items (owners)
- Tom: upload s3 manifest + prompts to shared drive (Claire to assist) — due EOD 2027-05-06
- Claire: provide labeled sample and confirm allowlist — due EOD 2027-05-06
- Soojin: send prompt template + onboarding runbook (attached) and provision sandbox once we have S3 access — ETA 48 hours after access
- Ben: prepare commercial MLP note in case we expand beyond pilot after 14 days
- Marissa: will draft success metrics tracker and invite a weekly 30-min cadence starting 2027-05-11

Security & compliance note
- We’ll redact any PII fields during ingestion and run the trial under a data-processing agreement. If your security team needs a SOC2 checklist or enclave options, Ben will coordinate a short call next week.

Attach: prompt-template-ndjson.txt (template), Redwood-onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf

If there are no objections, we’ll treat the above as the mutual action plan and proceed once S3 access is shared. Happy to hop on a quick call if anything needs faster alignment.

Thanks —
Soojin

—
